:::{#sol-linearly-independent-practice}

No.
$\vecf{v}_1 + \vecf{v}_2 = \tp{(1, 3, 1)} = \vecf{v}_3$,
so

$$
1 \cd \vecf{v}_1 + 1 \cd \vecf{v}_2 + (-1) \cd \vecf{v}_3 = \vzero,
$$

with numbers $c_1 = 1$, $c_2 = 1$ and $c_3 = -1$ that are not all $0$.
By @def-linearly-independent,
the three vectors are [linearly dependent](#def-linearly-independent).

:::
